content: Official TypeScript MCP SDK (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk) is at v1.29.x stable (v1.x is the supported production release; v2 is beta). TypeScript is described as the protocol's native language; Streamable HTTP transport is the 2026 standard, recommend API-key header validation early in request pipeline rather than full OAuth 2.1 for simple deployments; token passthrough forbidden by spec.
